Routing observations:
- Do not select an option that is not explicitly listed. Option C was rejected for REQ-2400, 2402–2405, 2407–2410.
- Option C was accepted only for:
  - Large shipment from the south region (REQ-2401, REQ-2406).
- Therefore, “large shipment + south” appears to route to the regional office (C), but this rule is not established for other request types, regions, or sizes.
- For renewal/claim requests and east/north cases, C was invalid; choose only A (standard queue) or B (priority desk) when those are the available choices.
- Ticket urgency wording (“asking twice,” “second attempt”) and sender department did not establish a reliable routing rule.

Routing observations:
- Select only an explicitly listed option.
- Confirmed: large shipment from the south region → C (regional office), including REQ-2401, 2406, and 2416.
- East:
  - Small claim → A (standard queue), confirmed by REQ-2410 and 2417.
  - Large invoice → A, confirmed by REQ-2414.
  - Large renewal → B confirmed by REQ-2413; REQ-2415 also rejected A, supporting B.
- North:
  - A is invalid for large invoice (REQ-2411) and large claim (REQ-2412). No successful alternative was observed; do not infer C without evidence.
- South:
  - A is invalid for small renewal (REQ-2418) and small shipment (REQ-2419). The correct alternative is not yet confirmed.
- Existing evidence still supports that C is not generally valid for renewal/claim or east/north cases.
- Ticket wording (“asking twice,” “second attempt,” “no rush,” etc.) has not established a reliable routing rule.
- Sender/department may matter: REQ-2413 and REQ-2415 have the same apparent request details and wording but opposite results for B vs. A; treat sender effects as possible but unproven.
- Do not generalize the “large shipment + south → C” rule to other request types, regions, or sizes.

Routing observations:
- Select only an explicitly listed option; never invent options (REQ-2429: D rejected).
- South large shipment → C remains confirmed (REQ-2401, 2406, 2416). Do not generalize this to other types, sizes, or regions.
- East:
  - Small claim → A (REQ-2410, 2417, 2428).
  - Small invoice → A (REQ-2423, 2427).
  - Small refund → A (REQ-2421).
  - Large invoice → A (REQ-2414).
  - Large renewal → B (REQ-2413, 2415).
- North:
  - Small transfer → A (REQ-2420).
  - A is invalid for large invoice and large claim (REQ-2411, 2412).
  - B is also invalid for large shipment and large claim (REQ-2424, 2425). No valid alternative is confirmed; do not infer C.
- South:
  - Large renewal → B (REQ-2422).
  - Large transfer → A (REQ-2426).
  - A is invalid for small renewal and small shipment (REQ-2418, 2419); correct alternatives remain unconfirmed.
- Existing evidence does not establish C as generally valid for renewal/claim or east/north cases.
- Ticket wording (“asking twice,” “second attempt,” “no rush,” “same as last month,” etc.) has not yielded a reliable routing rule.
- Sender/department may matter, but remains unproven; identical apparent details can produce different outcomes.
- Treat each request type/region/size combination independently unless directly supported by successful evidence.

- Confirmed invalid routes:
  - North small invoice: A invalid (REQ-2434).
  - North small shipment: A invalid (REQ-2436).
  - North large invoice and large claim: A invalid (REQ-2411, 2412).
  - North large shipment and large claim: B invalid (REQ-2424, 2425); no valid alternative confirmed.
  - South small renewal and small shipment: A invalid (REQ-2418, 2419).
  - South small audit: A invalid (REQ-2439).

- Ticket wording and sender/department have not yielded reliable routing rules; identical apparent details may differ.
- Do not infer unconfirmed alternatives from invalid outcomes.

Routing observations:

- Treat every request type/region/size combination independently. Do not generalize from wording, sender, department, or one region/size/type to another.
- Do not infer alternatives from an invalid outcome.

Confirmed valid routes:
- South large: shipment → C; renewal → B; transfer → A; invoice → A.
- South small: refund → A; invoice → A.
- East small: claim → A; invoice → A; refund → A.
- East large: invoice → A; renewal → B; refund → A.
- North small: transfer → A.
- North large: transfer → A; invoice → B; renewal → B.

Confirmed invalid routes:
- North small: invoice → A; shipment → A.
- North large: invoice/claim → A; shipment/claim → B. No valid alternative confirmed for large shipment or claim.
- South small: renewal/shipment → A; audit → A.
- South small claim → A.
- South large audit → C. No valid alternative confirmed.
- East small claim → A remains confirmed valid despite repeated testing.
- South large invoice → A remains confirmed valid despite repeated testing.

Additional evidence:
- East large renewal → B and East large invoice → A were repeatedly confirmed.
- Sender/department and ticket phrasing (including urgency, regional-office references, and paperwork format) remain unreliable; similar wording can have different outcomes.
- Keep unknown combinations unresolved, and use only routes supported by direct successful evidence.

Routing observations:

- Treat each request type/region/size combination independently. Do not generalize from wording, sender, department, or another region/size/type.
- Do not infer alternatives from an invalid outcome.

Confirmed valid routes:
- South large: shipment → C; renewal → B; transfer → A; invoice → A; audit → D (new evidence supersedes prior audit → C).
- South small: refund → A; invoice → A.
- East small: claim → A; invoice → A; refund → A. Shipment → D was rejected; no valid route confirmed.
- East large: invoice → A; renewal → B; refund → A; claim → A.
- North small: transfer → A. Shipment → D was rejected; no valid route confirmed.
- North large: transfer → A; invoice → B; renewal → B.
- East large claim → A was accepted.
- South large invoice → A and East large invoice/renewal routes remain repeatedly confirmed.

Confirmed invalid routes:
- North small: invoice → A; shipment → A and D.
- North large: invoice/claim → A; shipment/claim → B; audit → A. No valid alternatives confirmed for large shipment, claim, or audit.
- South small: renewal/shipment/audit/onboarding → A; claim → A.
- South large: audit → C (superseded by accepted D).
- East large: audit → A; onboarding → A. No valid alternatives confirmed.
- East small: shipment → D.

Keep all other combinations unresolved; use only directly successful evidence.
